prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid view photo selection for custom pet: Redesign the custom photo upload screen with a grid layout and photo quality tips carousel to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: Support emails show 3 complaints about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive species showcase screen: Insert a new companion showcase screen before path selection featuring animated pet previews. (why: 23.8% of users drop off on choose_path with a long mean duration of 514s.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after desktop waiting generation: Move sign-in after pet waiting generation so users authenticate right before revealing their finished pet. (why: Sign-in drops 24% of users; placing authentication after pet generation increases user investment.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet generation progress bar and time estimate: Add an active status progress bar and visual time estimate to the waiting screen while the pet generates. (why: The home target step (waiting screen) has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
4: [adoption, copy] Photo quality guidance guidelines copy: Update photo upload headline and body copy with clear criteria for high-quality pet photo uploads. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly.)
5: [finish, hint] System tray companion hint: Add a prominent hint explaining how to access the pet from the system tray if it disappears. (why: Support received 3 complaints about pets not showing on desktop or users not knowing how to control them.)
6: [home, notification] Background generation ready notification toggle: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet creation finishes. (why: Waiting step takes up to 2336s on average, leading to high abandonment rates.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Pet recovery sign-in clarity copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy emphasizing that signing in protects pets from resetting. (why: 8 support emails (the largest theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.)

scores.note: High drop step and support tickets, but prior redesign tests showed negative lift.

Sign-in reordering is the only historical change type with verified positive lift (+3.8%).
Provides progress feedback for home screen which suffers from long waiting times.
Config-only copy fix supported by support complaints on a high drop-off step.
Targets 35.2% finish drop-off and direct support emails regarding system tray navigation.
Mitigates extreme wait duration (2336s mean), but requires OS notification features.
Highest evidence score due to 8 support emails (largest theme) and minimal config-only cost.
